images.caption: Fig. 1:Overview of HazardAuditor.HazardAuditor combines executable safety supervision, Guard Policy Optimization, and a generative runtime guard within a unified framework. The infrastructure executes heterogeneous computer-use agents in controlled environments and converts their interactions into normalized behavioral evidence. GuardPO then aligns post-training with the trajectory-level safety decision while controlling the influence of variable-length rationales.

Fig. 2:Guard Policy Optimization.Standard token-mean optimization gives longer rationales greater aggregate
influence despite each response representing one safety decision. GuardPO
assigns a deterministic outcome to each response and separately normalizes
its rationale and verdict losses before aggregation, aligning policy
optimization with decision-level safety.
